projects.name: WalaOne
projects.context: Loyalty & rewards app for WalaPlus, part of a product suite serving 3M+ users across the loyalty ecosystem with 4.5+ app store ratings.
projects.challenge: Slow load times and a monolithic codebase were limiting growth and making new features costly to ship.
projects.contribution: Owned performance and architecture work — introduced caching, refactored core modules into a modular architecture, and built out unit test coverage.

projects.name: Doam
projects.context: Public-sector rewards platform built in partnership with Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Human Resources, serving 1.2M+ government employees.
projects.challenge: The product had to be built from zero — architecture, delivery pipeline, and engineering standards all had to be established for a high-stakes government partnership.
projects.contribution: Initiated and led development from scratch: designed the app architecture, set up CI/CD pipelines, and defined coding standards for the team.
impact: Delivered as a greenfield, production-grade platform

projects.name: Saudi German Health
projects.context: Large-scale healthcare mobile application for Saudi German Health, a leading hospital group — the current engagement at MEGAMIND IT Solutions.
projects.challenge: A legacy codebase and healthcare-grade reliability requirements meant stability and compliance had to be prioritized alongside feature velocity.
projects.contribution: Leading Flutter development, refactoring and modularizing the legacy codebase, implementing CI/CD and automated testing, and applying healthcare-grade security practices.
impact: Faster, more reliable release cycles via CI/CD

projects.name: WalaPlus
projects.context: The original WalaPlus loyalty and rewards app for employees and customers, part of the 3M+-user product suite.
projects.challenge: Performance and security needed to be strengthened without disrupting a live, high-traffic app.
projects.contribution: Implemented caching and API optimizations, added Mocktail-based unit testing, and applied a threat model to harden the app against reverse engineering and man-in-the-middle attacks.
impact: Hardened against reverse engineering & MiTM attacks

projects.name: WEDDnGO
projects.context: Egypt's largest wedding marketplace, connecting couples with service providers — featured on Shark Tank Egypt.
projects.challenge: The app needed vendor-facing and consumer-facing feature sets shipped reliably to support a fast-growing, newly-funded startup.
projects.contribution: Delivered vendor subscriptions, booking systems, and in-app payments, and optimized load times and responsiveness across the app.
impact: Helped secure Shark Tank Egypt funding

projects.name: PDentalCore
projects.context: Independent freelance project: a practice-management app for dental professionals.
projects.challenge: Dental practices needed one tool to manage clinical and financial workflows instead of juggling separate systems.
projects.contribution: Designed and built the app end-to-end — appointments, patient records, X-rays, medications, surgeries, and clinical notes, plus revenue/expense tracking.
impact: End-to-end freelance delivery, from design to release
Consolidated clinical & financial workflows in one app
